Response A stays under the 120-word limit, at roughly 103 words by my count. Response B runs to about 127 words, which breaks the explicit constraint.

A is also accurate and more precise. It names the expired intermediate certificate on connector B and gives owners and dates for the open actions. B says "outdated" rather than "expired" and leaves out the owners.

Both cover the key points a busy manager needs: impact, cause, slow detection and fixes.
